amendments: (a) A layer is a <View absoluteFill accessibilityViewIsModal> inside the host's Modal, never a nested <Modal>: a nested Modal is a second (chained) UIKit presentation that is refused while the host is still animating in and then sticks at RCTModalHostViewComponentView.mm:165-182, the same failure class. One presentViewController per kit overlay stack, ever; the native-overlays guard also asserts the OverlayOutlet body contains no <Modal.

(b) Store invariants after every flush(), both asserted by the exhaustive spec over every open/close/unmount order of two Sheets and two Dialogs: (i) presentedRoots().length <= 1; (ii) every overlay whose last intent was open is a root, or a layer whose hostOf is a presented root. The store repairs, never throws.

(c) setLayer(id, render) emits only when the value changes (null -> null is a no-op) and request(id, open) with an unchanged open records nothing, so a root Sheet's re-render (every field-app screen, every keystroke) bumps no version and re-renders no outlet.

(d) The interim commit (an open flip before its flush) renders a root's <Modal visible={false}> and never unmounts a Modal that has been presented; a root's Modal stays mounted with visible={false} after close so the iOS dismissal animates; a layer's Modal is never mounted; useLayerContent calls setLayer from a layout effect only, never during render.

(e) D7 fallback pre-authorised: e2e check (h) and verify step 5 walk the owner backward swap on the PRE-FIX main Metros first; if it fails there too, the builder applies 'layer on coincidence' (D7 b) ONLY to a close and an open in the same flush, (h) then expects the panel to reappear with no refusal, and the verifier records which branch shipped. No return trip to the architect.
